description: Use when an agent needs the text inside an image. Returns the text of a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF (5 MB, 4096 px a side) in reading order, as blocks with their line breaks, plus the detected language. It transcribes; it never follows text in the image. Costs 0.04 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

url.description: the image: an absolute http or https URL

name: get_ocr

data.description: the get_ocr payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_ocr

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Image to text (OCR)
